==About==

{{i|Cranberry}} can be Picked from a {{i|Cranberry Bush}}. Learning the [[Flowers & Berries]] Skill will allow you to Pick more Cranberry from each Bush. A Cranberry can be stored a {{i|Berry Sack}}.
